claim_summary: For fixed supercritical reproduction and fixed total two-deme migration, the uniformly averaged survival probability decreases strictly with absolute migration asymmetry. Under full redistribution the favored source deme has exactly one interior survival-optimal asymmetry, given by a unique scalar root; symmetric suppression has a strictly positive exact quadratic curvature.
limitations: Two types, identical reproduction multiplier lambda>1, independent Poisson child counts, strictly interior column-stochastic migration.
Average establishment assumes an equally likely initial type.
The unique advantaged-deme optimum is proved only for the complete-redistribution family s=1.
Finite-population fixation, density regulation and rare-migration regimes are outside the proof.
Literature priority is not exhaustively certified.
scientific_integrity: Theorem is exact only for the positive survival fixed point of a two-type supercritical Poisson Galton-Watson process. It is not an exact finite-deme fixation theorem; analytical proof provided, independent audit unperformed.
title: Exact migration-asymmetry ordering and a unique advantaged-deme optimum in a two-deme branching model
